description: Find the endoflife.date product slug for an everyday name or alias ("postgres", "k8s", "node", "windows server") and check whether a product is tracked at all. Matches names, labels and aliases and returns the best matches first. Use it before the other end-of-life tools. Source: endoflife.date product list (about 490 products); untracked software returns no match. (cost: 1 credit)

limit.description: integer, optional, matches to return, 1-50, default 10

query.description: string, required, product name or alias, 2-80 characters

name: eol_product_search
